WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(ta.avg_usage) AS mean_station_average,
       AVG(ta.avg_usage - b.avg_usage) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM telescope_averages AS ta
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE ta.avg_usage > b.avg_usage;
